servinfo.title: Rear Wheel Hub Assembly Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove rear wheel.
Disconnect rear wheel speed sensor connector and detach rear wheel speed sensor grommets.
Remove rear hub mounting bolts (1), and then remove rear wheel hub assembly (2) and rear brake disc dust cover (3).
Remove rear wheel speed sensor from rear wheel hub assembly.
Remove hub bolts (1) with copper hammer or hydraulic press, if necessary.

attention4.ptxt: Removing the hub bolts will break the serrations on the hub bolts.
Avoid removing the hub bolts unless their replacement is absolutely necessary. If the hub bolts are removed, never reuse the bolts.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Install rear wheel hub assembly positioning socket installed with the speed sensor to the lower side.
Tighten new rear hub mounting bolts (1) to specified torque.

attention4.ptxt: The rear hub mounting bolts are pre-coated with friction stabilizer. If the bolts are reused, they may work loose.
Use new rear hub mounting bolts.
